claude.rationale: The slice describes a whole-company, cash-out merger in which "the pre-existing legal entity, its office-products/business-supply operating business, and its customer-facing brand passed intact to the new private-equity ownership as a single surviving corporation," so the customer-facing product (T4) and the operational processes (T5) that produce/deliver it crossed the boundary together within the same surviving entity — no product-vs-process mismatch (gap_45=0). The officer/management tier "continued unchanged" alongside the operating business, so processes (T5) and organization/people (T6) transferred coherently together (gap_56=0). Only the controlling/governance tier was replaced (entire outside board resigned in favor of two acquiring-fund nominees), coding T1 as replace, while T2–T6 all moved one-to-one within the intact surviving corporation.

gemini.rationale: The transaction was a whole-company merger where the 'office-products/business-supply operating business, and its customer-facing brand passed intact to the new private-equity ownership as a single surviving corporation,' indicating no structural gap between the product and its underlying processes (gap_45 = 0). Additionally, 'the officer/management tier that runs day-to-day operations continued unchanged,' demonstrating that the organizational layer transferred coherently alongside the operational processes (gap_56 = 0).

openai.rationale: The structural summary states that the office-products/business-supply operating business and customer-facing brand passed intact together as part of the single surviving corporation, so no product-process mismatch existed at closing [SRC: SEC accession 0001047469-17-004941, DEFM14A; SEC accession 0001104659-17-056727, Form 8-K item 2.01]. The officers serving immediately before the effective time continued as officers of the surviving corporation, while the interim covenant required preservation of the business organization and ordinary-course operations through closing; therefore, no process-organization mismatch is documented [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-17-056725, Form 8-K item 5.02; SEC accession 0001047469-17-004941, DEFM14A].
